SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT SO06.CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO , SO06.ORDR_SEQ FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPCON.KEPMPSO05 SO05 WHERE SO06.CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKOLO0035C001','KRKOLO0037C001','KRKOLO0044C001') AND SO06.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('SS03','SS05') AND SO06.ORDR_NO = SO05.ORDR_NO ORDER BY SO06.CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO , SO06.ORDR_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT DECODE(SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD,'SS05','D',DECODE(SO06.USE_CHK,'Y','C','D')) AS STATUS , SUBSTR(SO06.CSTMR_ID,1,10) AS BUYER , REPLACE(SO06.ORDR_NO,SO06.CSTMR_ID,'') AS PO_NO , TO_CHAR(SO06.ORDR_SEQ,'FM000000') AS PO_SEQ , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , SUBSTR(SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ,1,10) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ1 , F_SPLIT(SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ,'-',1) AS PO_LINE_NO , F_SPLIT(SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ,'-',2) AS PO_SHIPMENT_ID , GETALANCINFO(SO06.SPPLR_ID,'ALANC_NM') AS SELLER_NAME , REPLACE(GETALANCINFO(SO06.SPPLR_ID,'RPRSNT_PHON_NO'),'-','') AS SELLER_TELNO , GETALANCINFO(SO06.SPPLR_ID,'RPRDR_NM') AS SELLER_PERSON_NAME , (SELECT MIN(DLVRY_PLAN_DATE) FROM KEPMPPO02 PO02, KEPMPRS02 RS02 WHERE SO06.CSTMR_ID = PO02.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_NO = PO02.ORDR_NO AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = PO02.ORDR_SEQ AND PO02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND PO02.PLCORD_NO = RS02.PLCORD_NO AND PO02.PLCORD_SEQ= RS02.PLCORD_SEQ AND RS02.USE_CHK='Y') AS DS_DATE FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06 WHERE 1=1 AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = '$G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$' AND SO06.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('SS03','SS05') ORDER BY SO06.ORDR_NO,SO06.ORDR_SEQ
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE SO06.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = '$G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE SO06.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = '$G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$'
